newsitem.title: USA: G7 ministers seek continued world growth--Rubin.
newsitem.headline: G7 ministers seek continued world growth--Rubin.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Saturday said that G7 finance ministers and central bankers had concluded a "very interesting meeting" at a time when various countries in the world are doing well.
"It's a good time for world growth," Rubin told reporters at the conclusion of G7 talks today.
"We talked a lot about how to continue that," he said.
Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin, also exiting the meeting, told reporters that multilateral debt and surveillance issues had been among the major topics of conversation.
When asked what topics had been discussed at the meeting, Martin replied, "multilateral debt and, of course, surveillance."
